title.narrative: Youth eco & livelihood empowerment via greenpeneurship & digital transf in CIV

description.narrative: Active

Goals The project aims to empower Ivorian youth by enhancing digital access and economic participation through the development of digital infrastructure, ICT skills and Green practices training, and fostering green entrepreneurship. Objectives The project aims to enhance youth digital access and foster green entrepreneurship, utilizing various means such as establishing digital infrastructure, providing basic and higher levels ICT skills programs along with green practices programs, organizing Greenpreneurs incubation program, creating an enabling environment for green entrepreneurship, and building the capacity of Ivorian government and institutions on digital green ecosystem.

The goal of the project is to enhance the digital capacity of the youth in the Greater Abidjan and Grand Bassam district of Cote d’Ivoire. It will look at improving economic development, social living conditions and political awareness by encouraging youth entrepreneurship, digital capabilities through ICT. It will create an ecosystem that can serve as a basis for the development of the local digital economy. The project aims at directly benefiting 152 100 direct beneficiaries representing 220 digital entrepreneurs, 150 700 students, 180 young drop out of school, 1000 young people promoting peace and good governance. The project would benefit 886 900 indirect beneficiaries The project will - promote digital entrepreneurship and increase students and dropped school youth digital skills for better market access. - accelerate access to digital by TVET promotion, digital software certification and women digital capacities building. - increase young people participation to political life through digital sensitization.
